breaking_news.headline: FBI seizing evidence at California plant where chemical tank overheated
breaking_news.summary: Federal authorities served a search warrant on Wednesday at a Southern California aerospace facility where a chemical tank overheated last month, forcing 50,000 residents to evacuate because authorities feared an explosion.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX blasts off with a record-breaking $75 billion IPO
breaking_news.summary: Elon Musk's rocket company, recently merged with xAI, raised $75 billion in its initial public stock offering. It's the first of a trio of mega-IPOs from AI companies expected this year.

breaking_news.headline: Small Business Administration stops lending to green card holders
breaking_news.summary: For decades, immigrants who are legal permanent residents in the U.S. could get loans through the Small Business Administration, a core pillar of small-business lending. Not anymore.

breaking_news.headline: How companies can sneak new chemicals past the FDA — and into our food and supplements
breaking_news.summary: There's a sneaky way companies add new chemicals in our food, and it is there by design, and totally legal.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO expected to set record when it goes public Friday
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX will go public on the NASDAQ Friday, likely to set a record as the most valuable IPO in history. NASDAQ is making a big play for IPOs, with new rules aimed at drawing in companies like SpaceX.

breaking_news.headline: Can smartphones help explain the drop in birth rates?
breaking_news.summary: Are smartphones causing people to have fewer children?  A provocative new working paper explores the persistent drop in birth rates since the iPhone was introduced nearly two decades ago.

breaking_news.headline: Door shuts on some immigrant entrepreneurs as U.S. restricts small-business loans
breaking_news.summary: For decades, immigrants who are legal permanent residents in the U.S. could get loans through the Small Business Administration, a core pillar of small-business lending. Not anymore.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX stock lifts off, rising above its IPO price
breaking_news.summary: The initial public offering from the rocket and AI company raised some $75 billion, making the company one of the biggest in the world — and likely making Elon Musk a trillionaire.

breaking_news.headline: Mother finds body of missing son two days after Kenya's Ebola quarantine centre protests
breaking_news.summary: Sylvester Muigai Ndung'u was in Nanyuki to fetch a school uniform on Tuesday, his mother says.

breaking_news.headline: More time needed for deadly Air India crash inquiry, officials say
breaking_news.summary: A statement says "significant progress" has been made into investigating the crash, in which 260 people died a year ago.

breaking_news.headline: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha dies after more than three years in coma
breaking_news.summary: Princess Bajrakitiyabha, the king's eldest daughter, collapsed in December 2022 while exercising her dogs.

breaking_news.headline: Taylor Swift makes tearful 21-minute speech as she joins Songwriters Hall of Fame
breaking_news.summary: The singer thanks her family as she becomes the youngest woman to be inducted into the Hall of Fame.

breaking_news.headline: King leads tributes to 'giant of the art world' David Hockney
breaking_news.summary: The artist, who has died at the age of 88, "was one of life's true originals", King Charles says.

breaking_news.headline: Discovery of €1.2m jewellery prompts fresh probe into former Spanish PM
breaking_news.summary: José Luis Rodriguez Zapatero is suspected of being unable to show proof he paid import duties on the jewellery.

breaking_news.headline: French town buries murdered child as questions mount over police failings
breaking_news.summary: The prime suspect in the killing of Lyhanna, 11, was reported to police nine months prior but never questioned.

breaking_news.headline: Iran says deal to end fighting with US has 'never been closer'
breaking_news.summary: Both Iran and Pakistan say a deal has never been closer - echoing US President Donald Trump's statement on Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Ryanair investigated over charging parents to sit with children
breaking_news.summary: The UK's competition regulator is investigating the airline over charges it imposes on parents to sit next to their child.

breaking_news.headline: UK signals it may block payout to British Steel owner
breaking_news.summary: Chinese firm Jingye is seeking compensation after the government decided to nationalise the company.

breaking_news.headline: Elon Musk's SpaceX raises $75bn ahead of world's biggest stock market launch
breaking_news.summary: The public sale is also expected to make Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire.

breaking_news.headline: India's 'blue gold' starts a new drinks industry
breaking_news.summary: Agave plants grow wild in India and new distillers are using them to create a spirits industry.
